answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the copper queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1043 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 44 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
